axes_units: y-axis: Probability of survival to 60 years (%) from 0 to 100; x-axis: Years (1950, 2000, 2019, 2020, 2048)
summary: The figure shows the probability of survival to 60 years of age across WHO regions and globally from 1950 to projections in 2048. All regions show an increasing trend in survival probability over time, with the European and Western Pacific regions having the highest probabilities by 2048, exceeding 90%. The African Region consistently has the lowest survival probabilities, though it shows improvement over time. The global probability also increases steadily, reaching 86.2% by 2048.
